interpretation: Minimize 3.25*A-Q+0.05*R. Q sums arithmetic means of raw reviewer overall_score for accepted review-history decisions; unreviewed acceptance contributes zero Q but incurs acceptance cost. R counts all actual reviews, accepted or rejected. Institution-written final_score is NOT used. Coefficients encode an explicit illustrative publication/review cost preference, not an empirically calibrated science-quality law. Reject-all and all-accept are legal; no hidden veto.
